mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following YoY GDP acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5 percentage point rise over the past 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp UNRATE spike.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production, defined as a 2% year-over-year decrease in the industrial production index, signals a supply-driven economic slowdown that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months following a 2% YoY drop in industrial production.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, defined as a 10% month-over-month decline, signals a weakening housing market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 10% MoM drop in housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4%, an additional 25 basis point hike signals a tightening monetary policy that will pressure equity valuations and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months when FEDFUNDS > 4% and rises 25bps.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 5%, a 0.3 percentage point increase signals a tightening labor market that will boost wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months when UNRATE < 5% and rises 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in retail sales, defined as a 2% month-over-month gain, signals a surge in consumer spending that will boost corporate revenues and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following a 2% MoM jump in retail sales.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the consumer price index, defined as a 0.5% month-over-month decline, signals a deflationary shock that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months following a 0.5% MoM drop in CPI.
